title: Anigma Architecture Sentinel Result
description: Schema for Anigma Architecture Sentinel validation results. Defines the structure of JSON output emitted by the architecture sentinel validator.

schema_version.description: Version of the sentinel schema. Must be 'anigma.architecture_sentinel.v1'.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sentinel result was generated.

status.description: Overall status of the architecture validation.

exit_code.description: Exit code that would be returned to the shell.

issue_count.description: Total number of issues found across all surfaces.

issues.description: List of architecture issues detected by the sentinel.

code.description: Unique identifier for this type of issue.

surface.description: Which architecture surface was being checked when this issue was found.

path.description: File path or location where the issue was detected (relative to repo root).

line.description: Line number in the file where the issue was detected (1-indexed). Optional if not known.

why_it_matters.description: Explanation of why this issue violates architecture doctrine.

expected_shape.description: Description of what the correct architecture should look like.

agent_instruction.description: Exact instruction for an agent to fix this issue.

related_validator.description: Name of related validator that also checks for this issue.

checked_surfaces.description: List of architecture surfaces that were checked and their results.

surface.description: Name of the architecture surface checked.

checked_paths.description: List of paths that were checked for this surface.

error.description: Error message if the surface check failed to run.

missing_required_artifacts.description: List of required artifacts that are missing or failed.

warnings.description: List of warning messages that don't cause failure.

agent_repair_prompt.description: Agent-readable instructions for repairing all issues. Must be present even on pass.

sentinel.description: Information about the sentinel validator itself.

path.description: Relative path to the sentinel script.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the sentinel script.

authoritative.description: Whether this sentinel result is authoritative. Must always be true.
